upstream.import: importlib spec_from_file_location under module name 'vicreg_upstream_main_vicreg' (wrapper module is also named main_vicreg, plain 'import main_vicreg' would self-resolve when src/tools is on sys.path); repo dir on sys.path for sibling imports (augmentations, distributed, resnet); sys.dont_write_bytecode=True. Repo dir = $VICREG_REPO_DIR or <project>/repo/vicreg; ImportError if main_vicreg.py missing.

tools.name: vicreg_compute_loss
tools.binding: Same as scanner/executor driver notebooks/vicreg_loss/run_reference.py: single-process gloo group (file:// init, world_size=1) created once if not initialized and kept for the server lifetime; VICReg.__new__ + nn.Module.__init__; args=Namespace(batch_size=n, sim_coeff, std_coeff, cov_coeff, mlp=str(d)); num_features=d; backbone=projector=nn.Identity; torch.no_grad(). Total loss = forward with user coefficients; unweighted terms = forward with (1,0,0),(0,1,0),(0,0,1). Upstream calls serialized with a threading.Lock.

parameters.embeddings_path: required; 2-D [n,d]; .npy (np.load, allow_pickle=False) or header-less numeric .csv (',') / .tsv ('\t') / .txt (whitespace) via np.loadtxt(ndmin=2); no header detection
parameters.embeddings_prime_path: required; same formats; must have same shape
parameters.dtype: Literal['float32','float64'] = 'float32' (upstream trains in float32; upstream forward does not cast)
parameters.output_dir: None -> <project>/tmp/outputs; fresh subdir vicreg_loss_<UTC timestamp>_<uuid8> per call

io_adaptations: file loading and dtype cast (numpy -> torch.from_numpy)
args.batch_size=n instead of upstream 2048 so the covariance denominator is (n-1) for the supplied batch (scanner binding)
args.mlp=str(d)/num_features=d so covariance is normalized by the supplied embedding dimension
tools.scientific_transformations_added: none; weighted_contributions in the JSON are coefficient * unweighted term (display arithmetic only, not a recomputation of the loss)

outputs.artifact: vicreg_loss.json with total_loss, invariance_loss, variance_loss, covariance_loss, weighted_contributions, n_samples, n_features, coefficients, dtype, input paths, method, reference

tools.diagnostics: one line to stderr per call; nothing printed to stdout (import verified silent on stdout)
